highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.4 fixes glyph-atlas reuse and shared stencil tracking.

bullets.lead: Correct GPU text and stencil state
bullets.detail: Prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from treating evicted glyph locations as current, and tracks shared stencil-clear rectangles in backend-native coordinates.
Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.

harfbuzz_summary: Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.

v4.150.4.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.4 corrects glyph-atlas reuse and shared stencil tracking.
